Molteau''' (Japanese: '''アルドル山''' ''Mt. Ardres'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]] that was featured in ''[[XY086|A Legendary Photo Op!]]''. The active volcano is located between [[Dendemille Town]] and [[Anistar City]]. While passing by, {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} encountered their old friend {{an|Trevor}} at Mt. Molteau. Trevor was keen to get a photo of {{p|Moltres}}, having already taken a picture of the other [[legendary birds]], {{p|Articuno}} and {{p|Zapdos}}. Using {{an|Clemont}}'s [[Clemontic Gear|Rock Searcher Mark 1]], the group searched for Moltres, which later malfunctioned after being kicked by [[Jessie]]. Trevor and the group arrived at the top of Mt. Molteau, only to discover that {{TRT}} had followed them. A battle ensued, but was disrupted by Moltres as it emerged from the volcano. The [[Legendary Pokémon]] easily blasted off Team Rocket with {{m|Flamethrower}}. Moltres then turned its attention to the group. [[Ash's Fletchinder]] and [[Trevor's Charmeleon]] took on Moltres. however Moltres proved too powerful. Fletchinder eventually evolved into {{p|Talonflame}} and learned {{m|Brave Bird}}. Despite evolving, Talonflame was overpowered by Moltres's {{m|Fire Blast}} and was falling without senses into the volcano. Ash jumped to save it and {{AP|Frogadier}}'s frubbles helped them back up. Moltres flew away after understanding that Ash and his friends weren't enemies. The group left Mt. Molteau, with Trevor revealing that he was able to get a picture of Moltres. ==Pokémon seen on Mt.
